items.description: Google Search Console is sending out emails informing site owners how many people are subscribing or following them as a preferred source on Google. It says "people are choosing domain as a preferred source" and then lists the number of "Preferred source selections."

items.title: Final Phase Of Google September 2026 Spam Update Rollout Oct 4-6?
items.description: I believe we are seeing the final phase of the Google September 2026 Spam update rolling out between October 4th and October 6th, today. The update should be done any day now, so there may be another spike in volatility, but I suspect this is it - we are pretty much done with this spam update.

items.title: Updated Google Maps Policy: What Merchants Can't Post In Listings Or Posts
items.description: Google has updated the Google Maps and Business Profiles Prohibited & restricted content policy's advertising and solicitation section to list what merchants and business owners cannot post on their listings and posts.

items.title: Google Search Generative AI Control Page Adds Top-Level Domain Details
items.description: Google has added information to the Search generative AI control page in Search Console about when a child property overrides the parent setting for AI controls.

items.title: Google Ads Call Extensions Includes Advertiser Name
items.description: Google Ads is testing displaying the advertiser's name within the click to call phone number call asset on the sponsored listings. Normally, Google will just show the phone number but in this test, Google is also adding the advertiser's name.

items.title: Google Search Console Performance Report Multi-Select Country Filters
items.description: Google now lets you check off multiple countries within the Google Search Console country filter in the performance reports. This lets you group countries together, to see how your search performance is doing for multiple countries at once, instead of one country at a time.

items.title: Google On Large Product Aggregator Websites
items.description: Google's John Mueller was asked why Google continues to crawl tons of pages on a large website but indexes only four of them, and why the home page isn't indexed. John categorized the site as a "large product aggregator."

items.title: Google Warns Against Deceptive Authorship Information Within Content
items.description: Around the same time Google updated its helpful content search documentation with defining main content and the new EOT/SA sections, Google also posted a warning to "avoid using deceptive authorship information."

items.title: OpenAI Tests New Product Labels On ChatGPT Results
items.description: OpenAI is testing new labels appended to the ChatGPT product results. These labels can add information about the product it is displaying, such as "best all-rounder," "best for beginners," "best cushioning," and so on.

items.title: Search Central Live Deep Dive Europe 2026: Meet the community speakers
items.description: It's happening! We are absolutely pumped that we're just about two weeks away from Search Central Live Deep Dive Europe 2026! From September 30 to October 2, 2026, the Google Search Central team is heading to the gorgeous city of Barcelona, Spain for three days of deep technical exploration, networking, and collaboration.

items.title: Search Central Live India 2026: Bengaluru, We're Coming (For Real This Time)
items.description: Remember back in March when we told our Indian community to "sit tight" while we figured out the APAC event calendar? Hopefully, you didn't take that too literally, because sitting tight for six months is probably not great for your back. In any case, you can finally stand up and stretch: Search Central Live is officially returning to India in 2026, specifically to Bengaluru!

items.title: Update to the Site Reputation Policy
items.description: In 2024, we introduced our site reputation policy to stop a practice where third-party content is published on a trusted website just to exploit that site's good reputation to rank higher in Search. This practice hurts search quality, and creates a bad experience for users.

items.title: Platform properties roll out globally, plus a new social and video performance guide
items.description: Earlier this month, we announced platform properties for Search Console, allowing you to track how your social and video posts on Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube perform on Google Search, Discover, and Google News. Today, platform properties are globally available to everyone.

items.title: See how content from social and video platforms performs on Google Search
items.description: Content creators and publishers use many channels beyond their own websites to reach their audiences. As people gravitate toward firsthand perspectives and different content formats, we want to make it easier for site owners and creators&mdash;even those without their own website&mdash;to get a consolidated view of how all of their content is getting discovered on Search.

items.title: Search Central Deep Dive Europe 2026: Apparently we're going to Barcelona
items.description: We're excited to officially announce the next stop for Search Central Live Deep Dive Europe 2026! Mark your calendars: based directly on your feedback, we're headed to Barcelona, Spain, from September 30 to October 2, 2026.

items.title: Help Us Pick the Next Stop in Europe for Search Central Live Deep Dive 2026!
items.description: As we mentioned a few months ago, we are bringing the Search Central Live Deep Dive format to the EMEA region. This SCL format requires finding the absolute best home for the event&mdash;a place where all of you can truly connect, learn, and enjoy.
